metric: explanation subjects 313 (previously 323); property:protein.tdl purpose null, claims [], limitations []
observation: The rebuilt explanation document held 313 subjects instead of 323, and node:protein, edge:associated_with and property:protein.tdl all came out with an empty meaning block: no claims, no limitations and a null purpose. The extractor was reading a semantics key that the current blueprint no longer emits, and the tdl property carried claims only. The document kept its other members, so the defect was confined to meaning resolution.
